cards.label: Bermondsey — James's unit
cards.text: James has cleared the second bench. On it: a scale, a tray of time ore, and his phone, open on BizBrief. Archie is leaning in the doorway, eating crisps.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "If I am to make the goods, someone has to tell me which goods. That is what Production is for."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Staff tab. Put me in Production. After that I work at the end of every block, the way Owen works the veins."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Manage tab. Every recipe has a target. I keep that many in stock and not one more. Raise it and I make more. Leave it at nothing and I sit on my hands."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "'Cover contract needs' means I also make whatever the open orders still want, on top of the target. Turn it on for anything you have sold."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "I work from the business's ore. No ore, no pearls. That part is yours and Owen's."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Which is why I found him something to make. Five pearls a week, same buyer, same day. It's on BizBrief."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Take it, put James on pearls, keep the ore coming. One full week, all five handed over. Then I'll show you the good bit."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "In full. Four pearls is not a week."
James sets the hourglass beside the scale and starts weighing out the first batch.
